# WinUIonWeb notices

This directory includes the following files from [WinUIonWeb](https://github.com/Furry-Xiyi/WinUIonWeb) by Furry-Xiyi:

- `components/WinButton.vue`
- `components/WinProgressRing.vue`
- `components/WinToggleSwitch.vue` (upstream ToggleSwitch behavior retained;
  its optional text-block dependency is replaced with native spans because
  EdgeSonic supplies each switch label in the surrounding control row)
- `styles/theme.css`

They are provided under GPL-3.0. EdgeSonic is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later, which is compatible with GPL-3.0. The full upstream license is in `LICENSE`.
